description: Source code for OpenAI video generation configuration and request/response transformation logic within the litellm project. Defines the OpenAIVideoConfig class that handles API interactions, request/response transformations, and utility methods related to OpenAI video models.

classes.name: OpenAIVideoConfig
classes.description: Configuration class for OpenAI video generation, including request building, response parsing, validation, and utility functions for integration with OpenAI's video APIs.

methods.description: Constructs the full API URL for video creation.
